projects.title: Pakistan Mutual Fund Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Data science system to analyse, compare, and forecast mutual fund performance using ML and macroeconomic indicators. Integrates NAV history, MUFAP data, PSX indicators, and global macro signals — producing 5-year NAV forecasts, Sharpe ratio analysis, and sector allocation breakdowns.

projects.title: Clio — Video Recommendation System
projects.description: Full-stack recommendation system using Alternating Least Squares (ALS) collaborative filtering on the MovieLens 100K dataset. Demonstrates end-to-end ML system design: data pipeline → model training → serving — the architecture patterns used in production recommendation systems.

projects.title: Parallel Genetic Algorithm for Feature Selection
projects.description: Evolutionary ML framework using genetic algorithms with Python multiprocessing to automatically select optimal features for classification. Benchmarks sequential vs parallel execution on a 64-feature digit recognition dataset — cutting training time from ~45s to ~20s while improving accuracy.

projects.title: Text-to-Video Generation Engine
projects.description: Generative AI engine for converting structured text prompts into video sequences. Exploring diffusion-based architectures and temporal coherence techniques for practical, real-world video synthesis.

projects.title: Predictive Risk Scoring Models
projects.description: Data-driven risk scoring systems focused on model interpretability for business stakeholders — making outputs explainable, auditable, and actionable without sacrificing predictive power. Designed to scale from notebook to production.
